label: looks like a real person?
instructions: Does the portrait description in quoted_text ask to look like a real person or an existing fictional character, by name or by an unmistakable description?
true: Yes: it names, or unmistakably describes, a real person or an existing fictional character.
false: No: it describes an original look, even when it names a job, an era or a style.
